guidance: Use Sonnet 5 for simpler, well-scoped tasks like writing pre-designed functions and modules
Use Opus 5 for more complex tasks like building large modules from scratch or complex refactors
Use Fable 5.1 only when there is truly complex or multi-part work that needs to be done, extremely difficult research, or coordination/planning for large groups of sub-agents.
Emulate the BMAD method's 'adverserial review' strategy when configuring the workflow for complex implementations (docs.bmad-method.org/explanation/adversarial-review/)
